#ifndef W25Q64JV_DRIVER_H
#define W25Q64JV_DRIVER_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

/* Callback type that the user must implement. It must perform a full SPI transaction.
 *   tx  – pointer to data to transmit (may be NULL if only receiving)
 *   rx  – pointer to buffer for received data (may be NULL if only transmitting)
 *   len – number of bytes in the transaction
 * Return 0 on success, non‑zero on error.
 */
typedef int (*w25q64jv_spi_transfer_t)(const uint8_t *tx, uint8_t *rx, size_t len);

/* Driver context – holds the user supplied transfer callback. */
typedef struct {
    w25q64jv_spi_transfer_t transfer;
} w25q64jv_t;

/* Command opcodes */
#define W25Q64JV_CMD_WRITE_ENABLE               0x06u
